title: A FastAPI analytics API on ClickHouse with tenant-scoped datasets
outcome: Serve governed ClickHouse analytics from FastAPI: datasets defined once in Python, query endpoints mounted beside your routes, tenant fixed by the token.

env.name: HYPEQUERY_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: HS256 secret shared by the token issuer and the verifier. The demo has an insecure default; set your own.

env.name: HYPEQUERY_DEV_DOCS
env.description: Set to 1 to serve the generated OpenAPI document and Swagger UI at /analytics/docs

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
env.description: ClickHouse password (default: hypequery, the seed's password)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE
env.description: Database holding the seed tables (default hypequery_examples)

exampleRequest: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST localhost:8000/auth/token -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"email":"ada@quartz.example"}' | jq -r .token) && curl -s -X POST localhost:8000/analytics/datasets/events/query -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"dimensions":["event_type"],"measures":["events","error_rate"]}'
